run.title: Run a calculation
run.subtitle: Each action stands on its own. A period is calculated only once — an existing run must be deleted before it is recalculated.
run.monthlyDesc: Rolls this car's drives into monthly distance totals per driver. Distances only, no costs.
run.monthlyExistsWarn: This month is already aggregated. Delete it below before redoing.
run.yearlyDesc: Rolls the year's months up, totals fixed and variable costs, derives factors, and writes the combined settlement.
run.yearlyHint: Aggregate all of the year's months first. Fixed-cost factors default to an equal split and are adjustable only by an admin in the database.

run.deleteDesc: Removes a stored monthly or yearly run so its period can be recalculated.

yearly.title: Yearly settlement
yearly.subtitle: One car's owed split per driver for the year.
yearly.explainer: Variable owed = variable factor × the car's variable total (the factor follows distance, so a non-fueler still pays for km driven). Fixed owed = fixed factor × the car's fixed total. This view shows what each driver owes; paid and net balance are combined across cars — see the combined settlement.

combined.title: Combined settlement
combined.subtitle: Net balance per driver across every car in their group.
combined.explainer: Variable / fixed diff. = what a driver paid of that cost type minus what they owe, summed across every calculated car. Net balance = the two differences added; positive means the group owes the driver. Each column nets to zero.

monthly.title: Monthly distances
monthly.subtitle: Per-driver kilometres by month for a car.
monthly.empty: No aggregated months for this car and year.

factors.title: Distribution factors
factors.subtitle: The factors that split this car's yearly costs. Variable follows distance; fixed defaults to an equal split.
factors.explainer: Factors are computed by the yearly run and are read-only here. Only an admin adjusts the fixed factor directly in the database.
